title: Two conveyors and a TON
statement: An S7-300 runs the two networks in the screenshot every $100$ ms. Start (I 0.0) is pressed at $t = 1.0$ s and let go at $1.5$ s; Stop (I 0.1, a normally closed button) is pressed at $8.0$ s. Fill in conveyor 1 (Q 4.0), the TON's elapsed time ET (MD 20) and conveyor 2 (Q 4.1) after the scan at each time.
given: Start on I 0.0, Stop on I 0.1 (normally closed: $1$ until pressed)
the TON in DB 1, PT $= 5$ s, ET in MD 20

artefact.caption: After the scan at each time

steps.title: Network 1 latches conveyor 1
steps.note: Start closes its contact at $1.0$ s and Q 4.0 comes on; from the next scan its own contact Q 4.0 holds the rung, so letting Start go changes nothing. Stop reads $1$ until it is pressed: its NO contact opens only at $8.0$ s.

steps.title: The TON counts ET
steps.note: Network 2 gives the TON's IN the value of Q 4.0. IN rises at $1.0$ s, so ET counts from there: $2000$ ms at $3.0$ s, and it stops at PT, $5000$ ms. When Q 4.0 drops, IN falls and ET goes back to $0$.

steps.title: Q 4.1 once ET reaches PT
steps.note: The TON's Q, and so conveyor 2, comes on in the scan where ET reaches PT: $1.0 + 5 = 6.0$ s. It drops with IN at $8.0$ s.

answer: Conveyor 1 runs from $1.0$ s to $8.0$ s; conveyor 2 starts at $6.0$ s, when ET reaches PT $= 5000$ ms, and stops with conveyor 1.

stated: Start pressed at $1.0$ s and let go at $1.5$ s
the input bits $0$ and $1$ in the table
